options.pcbQtyMinimum: 5 (smallest quantity on orderonline.aspx; GetDeliveryDays returns [] for 1-4)
options.method: POST https://www.pcbway.com/Quote/GetDeliveryDays/ (body captured from orderonline.aspx and quotesmt.aspx with agent-browser, replayed with curl; anonymous; partVias=1 turnkey, hidAssemblySide=3 top). Recipe: /tmp/pcbway-quote-recipe.md

notes: The README and pcbway-notes ask for no via fill and no impedance control (the USB pair is deliberately not impedance controlled), so both are off. Vias are tented as in the Gerbers. Panel: the README asks for 'Panel by supplier with break-away rails' on the long edges; quoted as single pieces to match the other runs, so panelisation is not priced. Assembly side: 'Top side'. All SMD parts are on top, and J6/J7 are through-hole headers inserted from the bottom and soldered from the top, so there is no bottom SMT pass. 'Both sides' gives the same normal price ($88.00 / $88.50) and a higher struck-through list price. THT parts = 2 (J6, J7; 24 joints per board). J1's plated shell legs are counted with J1 as an SMD part, as in the BOM; they need pin-in-paste or hand soldering, which goes in the order notes. BGA/QFP count entered as 0, like the other runs (U1 QFN-60 and U7 RM2 are counted as SMD parts). X-ray on U1 and U7 is requested but has no field or price in the instant quote; it is priced at review. Assembly: normal = max($88, $25.27 + $0.1523 x 83 parts x qty), so $88.00 for 1 board and $88.50 for 5. $29 promo: one board qualifies (24 THT joints). Five boards do not, because 24 x 5 = 120 THT joints exceeds the 100-joint order limit; the instant quote can't check joints and still shows $29. The struck-through 'list' price next to $29 ($240.39 at qty 1, $246.47 at qty 5) is the qty >= 11 formula and is not charged at these quantities.
